title: UEA MC Society
description: The official server for UEA! Play survival, factions, and participate in community events with your friends.
body:
# ⛏ UEA Minecraft Society ## Welcome to the Official UEA Minecraft Server! --- ### 🌟 Server Features This is a university Minecraft server offering a variety of ways to play: > * **SMP (Survival Multiplayer):** Features a fresh restart every academic year! > * **Creative Server:** Claim a plot and let your imagination run wild. > * **Factions Server:** Team up, build your base, and gather resources. > * **Community Events:** Keep an eye on our Discord and social media for announcements! --- ### 🏆 Events We Host We occasionally host action-packed mini-games and events open to everyone: > * 🏹 **Hunger Games** > * 🛏️ **Bedwars** > * ⛏️ **Spleef & Blockrun** > * 🏗️ **Build Battle** --- ### 🎮 How to Join the SMP Ready to play? Become an official Minecraft Society member here: 👉 **[Join Today!](https://www.ueasu.org/communities/societies/group/minecraft/)**
⚠️ Important Note This server is intended for university students of the University of East Anglia as a way of installing our modpack, Lucidity+, to play on some of our modded servers such as Factions.
